ev.q: From 2013 to 2020, rates increased for all groups, from 30.2 to 63.8 per 100,000 population for White persons
In 2020, the drug overdose death rate for White persons was the highest among all groups
From 2000 to 2013, the rate for drug overdose death increased for non-Hispanic White
Source: National Vital Statistics System, Mortality Data.

methods_quotes.q: Rates for 2000–2017 are based on multiple-race mortality data bridged to single-race categories
